title: Data Forwarding Unit
constraints: Mux select encoding: `00` = value read from the register file, `10` = forward from EX/MEM (ALU result of the previous instruction), `01` = forward from MEM/WB.
Forward from a stage only if it writes a register (`*_reg_write`), its destination is not x0, and it matches the source register.
When both stages match, **EX/MEM wins**: it holds the more recent value.
hints: Write one priority `if / else if` per operand: EX/MEM first, then MEM/WB, otherwise 00.
The `rd != 0` check matters: an instruction that writes x0 must never be forwarded.
Test the double-match case (`add x1…; add x1…; add x2, x1, x1`): the second add's result must win.

examples.title: both match
examples.input: ex_rs2 = x4, mem_rd = x4, wb_rd = x4 (both write)
